accepted_limits: This is a focused real-environment smoke for DOCX to RTF only; it does not close DOCX to WPS quality policy, LibreOffice-only fallback, styles, comments, images, headers/footers, or broad binary artifact comparison.

RTF output size differs across the three projects in this environment, so the checked-in fixture treats size as recorded metadata and compares normalized Word COM readback semantics instead of byte equality.
